<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ServiceForYourFridge"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/service-for-your-fridge">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceRequest" name="Symptoms and fridge type"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Appointment" name="Appointment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairCompleted" name="Fridge repaired"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FrIdgeNoises" name="Fridge produces strange noises"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DescribeSymptoms" name="Describe symptoms and fridge type"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendServiceRequest" name="Send symptoms and fridge type to central service center"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveAppointment" name="Receive appointment">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Appointment" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveRepairCompletion" name="Fridge repaired">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RepairCompleted" messageRef="Message_RepairCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK" name="Confirm fridge is OK again"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RateFacility" name="Rate service facility?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateFacility" name="Rate service facility"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeRating" name="Continue after optional rating"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Service confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_FrIdgeNoises" targetRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_DescribeSymptoms" targetRef="Task_SendServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRequest" targetRef="Event_ReceiveAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveAppointment" targetRef="Event_ReceiveRepairCompletion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveRepairCompletion" targetRef="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmFridgeOK" targetRef="Gateway_RateFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" name="Rate" sourceRef="Gateway_RateFacility" targetRef="Task_RateFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_8" name="Skip rating" sourceRef="Gateway_RateFacility" targetRef="Gateway_MergeRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_9" sourceRef="Task_RateFacility" targetRef="Gateway_MergeRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeRating" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CentralServiceCenter" name="Central fridge service center" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceRequest" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceRequest" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFacility" name="Select local service facility"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendFacilityRequest" name="Send service request to selected facility"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Center" name="Facility selected"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceRequest" targetRef="Task_SelectFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectFacility" targetRef="Task_SendFacilityRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Center_3" sourceRef="Task_SendFacilityRequest" targetRef="End_Center"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LocalServiceFacility" name="Local service facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_FacilityRequest" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FacilityRequest" messageRef="Message_ServiceRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeAppointment" name="Make appointment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendAppointment" name="Send appointment to customer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Arrive" name="Arrive at a random time"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PartsNeeded" name="Additional parts needed?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repairing because additional parts are needed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRepaired" name="Service not completed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairFridge" name="Repair fridge"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Repaired" name="Fridge repaired"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="Start_FacilityRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_2" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="Task_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_3" sourceRef="Task_SendAppointment" targetRef="Task_Arrive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_4" sourceRef="Task_Arrive" targetRef="Gateway_PartsNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_5" name="Additional parts needed" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsNeeded" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">additionalPartsNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_6" name="No additional parts needed" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsNeeded" targetRef="Task_RepairFridge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not additionalPartsNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_7" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="End_NotRepaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_8" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="End_Repaired"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ServiceForYourFridge">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CentralServiceCenter" name="Central fridge service center" processRef="Process_CentralServiceCenter"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LocalServiceFacility" name="Local service facility" processRef="Process_LocalServiceFacility"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceRequest" name="Symptoms and fridge type" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRequest" targetRef="Start_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FacilityRequest" name="Service request" sourceRef="Task_SendFacilityRequest" targetRef="Start_FacilityRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Appointment" name="Appointment" sourceRef="Task_SendAppointment" targetRef="Event_ReceiveAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairCompleted" name="Fridge repaired" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="Event_ReceiveRepairCompletion"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
